title: Jubilant Yeasty Thai Tagliatelle Khanom Krok
description: A yeasty, chewy, Thai-inspired brunch dish featuring tagliatelle and khanom krok, made in a Dutch oven. This egg-free friendly dish is perfect for a weekend morning.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the yeast, palm sugar, and warm water, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Add the coconut milk, vegetable oil, and salt to the bowl, stirring to combine.
Gradually add the tagliatelle to the bowl, stirring to coat the pasta evenly with the yeast mixture.
Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and let the mixture rest in a warm place for 1 hour, or until the yeast is activated and the mixture is bubbly.
Preheat the Dutch oven over medium heat, adding a small amount of oil to the bottom.
Add the khanom krok molds to the Dutch oven, filling each mold with the tagliatelle mixture and topping with sashimi-cut vegetables.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and cook for 10 minutes, or until the khanom krok are cooked through and the tagliatelle is tender.
Remove the khanom krok from the molds and serve hot, garnished with additional sashimi-cut vegetables if desired.
